name: nestweaver
stderr:
Code knowledge graph for AI agents

Usage: nestweaver [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  extensions                Read the custom annotations agents write via the `set_extension` MCP tool
  list-repos                List all indexed repositories
  remove-repo               Remove an indexed repository and all its data (symbols, files, services, contracts) from the graph
  remove-project            Remove a materialized project and its edges from the graph
  compact-embeddings        Reclaim embedding vectors left behind by deleted graph nodes
  prune-stale               Remove repos and vaults whose paths no longer exist on disk
  repair                    Reconcile an index publication abandoned by a crashed indexer
  stale-check               Check if the indexed graph is stale by comparing each repo's indexed SHA against git HEAD. (Same as `brain stale-check`.) Exit codes: 0 = every repo is fresh · 2 = at least one needs a re-index · 1 = the check itself could not run · 64 = bad usage
  rts-eval                  Measure affected-tests selection quality against full-suite outcomes: record ground truth from CI, report rolling recall
  list-services             List all services/modules in the graph
  service-summary           Show a service summary with entry points
  search                    Search symbols by name substring
  symbol                    Look up a symbol by name or UID
  read-symbols              Read a symbol's source span (start_line..end_line) — just the symbol, not the whole file. Optionally include adjacent symbols; token-budget aware
  regex-search              Regex search over indexed text (section bodies and their heading lines, note titles, frontmatter, symbol signatures)
  count-patterns            Count regex matches per pattern across indexed text (counts only)
  impact                    Analyze blast radius: what depends on this symbol
  pre-push-impact           Analyze the impact of local changes against the org-wide graph [alias: ppi]
  format-comment            Format impact analysis results as a PR/MR comment
  repo-map                  Generate a structural skeleton ranked by symbol importance
  cross-repo-contracts      Find cross-repository references and API contracts for a symbol
  backlinks                 Find notes that link to a note UID or title
  note                      Read a vault note's content and metadata — the read-only CLI twin of the `note_get` MCP tool an agent already has
  cross-repo-refs           Show cross-repo references for a symbol
  pull                      Pull repository source into a local workspace
  index                     Index a local repository into the code graph
  context                   Get task-focused context: structural subgraph around seed symbols
  list-links                List declared cross-repo links from an instance config
  list-features             List declared feature bundles from an instance config
  suggest-links             Analyze indexed repos and suggest cross-repo links and feature bundles
  instance                  Manage NestWeaver instances (register, list, remove, pull)
  brain                     Brain: unified knowledge graph over markdown vaults
  memory                    F11 memory-bank operations over the vault: typed-relationship health (`lint`), tier-promotion proposals (`consolidate`), and typed-edge traversal (`related`)
  mcp                       Run the brain as a Model Context Protocol server on stdio
  ui                        Start the web UI server with interactive graph visualization
  interactions              Manage interaction memory
  rerank                    Feature F17 — lightweight result reranker (off-by-default heuristic)
  contracts                 Inspect the API contract graph (F2-core)
  generate-guide            Generate an AGENTS.md codebase intelligence guide from the indexed graph
  admin                     Admin: subagent guidance instruction store and runtime hook installation
  snapshot                  Manage graph snapshots (build, verify, push)
  publication
